{{Top}}
[[File:Holocomm.jpg|thumb|200px|Holocomm]]
A '''holocomm''' was a communications unit for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. It enabled users to send and receive messages through holographic-based transmission networks.<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
